evidence_required: decision with criteria; every parameter with its number and label; one quantified trade-off; one risk you are accepting and how you would detect it in production.

marking.criterion: Decision (RoCEv2 or InfiniBand) with explicit criteria and loss model
Parameters with numbers and labels: 3-tier RTT and BDP, timeout/retry with time-to-failure, MTU, GID policy
One quantified trade-off (e.g. tail-loss cost at the design loss rate vs spurious-failure cost)
An accepted risk and how it is detected in production
Scale considerations for the readiness checklist at 512 nodes and single-NIC failure handling
